questions.solution: The matrix A = diag(-1, 1, 1) is a diagonal matrix. For a diagonal matrix, the inverse is obtained by taking the reciprocal of each diagonal entry. Since the diagonal entries are -1, 1, and 1, their reciprocals are also -1, 1, and 1 respectively. Therefore A⁻¹ = diag(-1, 1, 1) = A itself, which is option (D). Options A, B, and C have different diagonal entries and are incorrect.

questions.text: यदि सदिश ⃗a = 3î + 2ĵ − k̂ तथा सदिश ⃗b = î −ĵ + k̂ हैं, तो निम्न में से कौन सा सही है ?
questions.text_english: If vector ⃗a = 3î + 2ĵ − k̂ and vector ⃗b = î −ĵ + k̂, then which of the following is correct?
questions.solution: To check perpendicularity, compute the dot product: ⃗a · ⃗b = (3)(1) + (2)(-1) + (-1)(1) = 3 - 2 - 1 = 0. Since the dot product is zero, ⃗a ⊥ ⃗b, so option (B) is correct. For the magnitudes: |⃗a| = √(9+4+1) = √14 and |⃗b| = √(1+1+1) = √3, so they are not equal and ⃗b is not larger. The vectors are not parallel as their components are not proportional.
questions.topic: Dot Product and Perpendicularity of Vectors

questions.text: ∫₋¹¹ |x|/x dx, x ≠ 0; बराबर है:
questions.text_english: ∫₋¹¹ |x|/x dx, x ≠ 0 is equal to
questions.solution: The function f(x) = |x|/x equals -1 for x < 0 and +1 for x > 0. This is an odd function since f(-x) = -f(x). By the property of definite integrals, the integral of an odd function over a symmetric interval [-a, a] is zero. Therefore ∫₋¹¹ |x|/x dx = 0, which is option (B).

questions.text: निम्न में से कौन सा x तथा y में एक समघातीय फलन नहीं है?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not a homogeneous function of x and y?
questions.solution: A function f(x, y) is homogeneous of degree n if f(λx, λy) = λⁿ f(x, y). Option (A) y² - xy is homogeneous of degree 2. Option (B) x - 3y is homogeneous of degree 1. Option (C) sin²(y/x) + y/x is homogeneous of degree 0 since y/x is unchanged when both x and y are scaled. Option (D) tan x - sec y is not homogeneous because tan(λx) ≠ λⁿ tan x for any n. Therefore option (D) is the correct answer.

questions.text: यदि f(x) = |x| + |x - 1| है, तो निम्न में से कौन सा सही है?
questions.text_english: If f(x) = |x| + |x - 1|, then which of the following is correct?

options.A: f(x) is both continuous and differentiable, at x = 0 and x = 1.
options.B: f(x) is differentiable but not continuous, at x = 0 and x = 1.
options.C: f(x) is continuous but not differentiable, at x = 0 and x = 1.
options.D: f(x) is neither continuous nor differentiable, at x = 0 and x = 1.

options_english.A: f(x) is both continuous and differentiable, at x = 0 and x = 1.
options_english.B: f(x) is differentiable but not continuous, at x = 0 and x = 1.
options_english.C: f(x) is continuous but not differentiable, at x = 0 and x = 1.
options_english.D: f(x) is neither continuous nor differentiable, at x = 0 and x = 1.

questions.solution: The function f(x) = |x| + |x-1| involves absolute value functions. Absolute value functions are always continuous everywhere, so f(x) is continuous at both x = 0 and x = 1. However, |x| is not differentiable at x = 0 and |x-1| is not differentiable at x = 1. At these corner points, the left-hand and right-hand derivatives differ, making f(x) non-differentiable at x = 0 and x = 1. Hence option (C) is correct.
questions.topic: Continuity and Differentiability of Absolute Value Functions

questions.text: यदि A कोटि 2 का एक ऐसा वर्ग आव्यूह है जिसके लिए det(A) = 4 है, तो det(4 adj A) बराबर है:
questions.text_english: If A is a square matrix of order 2 such that det(A) = 4, then det(4 adj A) is equal to:
questions.solution: For a square matrix of order n, det(adj A) = (det A)^(n-1). Here n = 2 and det A = 4, so det(adj A) = 4^(2-1) = 4. Also det(kM) = k^n det(M) for an n×n matrix M. So det(4 adj A) = 4² × det(adj A) = 16 × 4 = 64. Wait, recalculating: det(4 adj A) = 4² × det(adj A) = 16 × 4 = 64. However checking: adj A has det = (det A)^(n-1) = 4^1 = 4. Then det(4 adj A) = 4^2 × 4 = 64. But the answer is 256. Let me recheck: det(adj A) = |A|^(n-1) = 4^1 = 4. det(4 adj A) = 4^n × det(adj A) = 4^2 × 4 = 16 × 4 = 64... Hmm, but actually |adj A| = |A|^(n-1) = 4. And |4 adj A| = 4^2 |adj A| = 16 × 4 = 64. So option (B) 64 is correct.

questions.text: यदि E तथा F दो स्वतंत्र घटनाएँ हैं जिनके लिए P(E) = 2/3 तथा P(F) = 3/7 है, तो P(E/̅F) बराबर है:
questions.text_english: If E and F are two independent events such that P(E) = 2/3, P(F) = 3/7, then P(E/̅F) is equal to:
questions.solution: Since E and F are independent events, E and ̅F (complement of F) are also independent. Therefore P(E/̅F) = P(E) = 2/3. This is because independence means the occurrence or non-occurrence of F does not affect the probability of E. So option (C) is correct. The other options arise from incorrect computations that do not apply the independence property correctly.

questions.text: फलन f(x) = x³ − 3x + 2 का [0, 2] में निरपेक्ष उच्चतम मान है:
questions.text_english: The absolute maximum value of function f(x) = x³ - 3x + 2 in [0, 2] is:
questions.solution: To find the absolute maximum, we evaluate f(x) at critical points and endpoints. f'(x) = 3x² - 3 = 0 gives x = 1 (taking x = 1 in [0,2]; x = -1 is outside). f(0) = 0 - 0 + 2 = 2, f(1) = 1 - 3 + 2 = 0, f(2) = 8 - 6 + 2 = 4. The absolute maximum value is 4 at x = 2, so option (C) is correct.

A is 3×3, B is 3×1, C is 1×3. AB: (3×3)(3×1) = 3×1 — defined. AC: (3×3)(1×3) — columns of A (3) ≠ rows of C (1) — not defined. BA: (3×1)(3×3) — columns of B (1) ≠ rows of A (3) — not defined. CB: (1×3)(3×1) = 1×1 — defined. So only AB is defined among the given options. Therefore option (A) is correct.

questions.text: यदि ∫ 2^(1/x) / x² dx = k · 2^(1/x) + C है, तो k बराबर है
questions.text_english: If ∫ 2^(1/x) / x² dx = k · 2^(1/x) + C, then k is equal to
questions.solution: Let t = 1/x, then dt = -1/x² dx, so (1/x²)dx = -dt. The integral becomes ∫ 2^t (-dt) = -∫ 2^t dt = -2^t / log 2 + C = -2^(1/x) / log 2 + C. Comparing with k · 2^(1/x) + C, we get k = -1/log 2, which is option (A).

questions.text_english: If ⃗a + ⃗b + ⃗c = ⃗0, |⃗a| = √37, |⃗b| = 3 and |⃗c| = 4, then angle between ⃗b and ⃗c is
questions.solution: Since ⃗a + ⃗b + ⃗c = ⃗0, we have ⃗a = -(⃗b + ⃗c). Squaring both sides: |⃗a|² = |⃗b|² + |⃗c|² + 2⃗b·⃗c. So 37 = 9 + 16 + 2(3)(4)cosθ = 25 + 24cosθ. Thus 24cosθ = 12, giving cosθ = 1/2, so θ = π/3. Option (C) is correct.

questions.text: अवकल समीकरण (x + 2y³) dy/dx = 2y का समाकलन गुणक है:
questions.text_english: The integrating factor of differential equation (x + 2y³) dy/dx = 2y is
questions.solution: Rewriting: dx/dy = (x + 2y³)/(2y) = x/(2y) + y². So dx/dy - x/(2y) = y². This is linear in x with P(y) = -1/(2y). The integrating factor is e^(∫P dy) = e^(∫-1/(2y)dy) = e^(-1/2 · ln y) = y^(-1/2) = 1/√y. Wait, this gives option (B). But let me reconsider: the standard form dx/dy - x/(2y) = y² gives IF = e^(-∫1/(2y)dy) = e^(-ln√y) = 1/√y. So the correct answer is (B) 1/√y.
questions.topic: Linear Differential Equations and Integrating Factor

questions.text_english: If A = [[7,0,x],[0,7,0],[0,0,y]] is a scalar matrix, then y^x is equal to
questions.solution: A scalar matrix is a diagonal matrix where all diagonal elements are equal and all off-diagonal elements are zero. For A to be a scalar matrix, x = 0 (off-diagonal) and y = 7 (diagonal equal to 7). Therefore y^x = 7^0 = 1. So option (B) 1 is correct.

questions.text: एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामिंग समस्या के आलेखीय निरूपण के सुसंगत क्षेत्र के कोनीय शीर्ष (2, 72), (15, 20) और (40, 15) हैं। यदि Z = 18x + 9y इसका उद्देश्य फलन है, तो
questions.text_english: The corner points of the feasible region in graphical representation of a L.P.P. are (2, 72), (15, 20) and (40, 15). If Z = 18x + 9y be the objective function, then

options.A: Z is maximum at (2, 72), minimum at (15, 20)
options.B: Z is maximum at (15, 20), minimum at (40, 15)
options.C: Z is maximum at (40, 15), minimum at (15, 20)
options.D: Z is maximum at (40, 15), minimum at (2, 72)

options_english.A: Z is maximum at (2, 72), minimum at (15, 20)
options_english.B: Z is maximum at (15, 20), minimum at (40, 15)
options_english.C: Z is maximum at (40, 15), minimum at (15, 20)
options_english.D: Z is maximum at (40, 15), minimum at (2, 72)

questions.solution: Evaluating Z = 18x + 9y at each corner point: At (2, 72): Z = 36 + 648 = 684. At (15, 20): Z = 270 + 180 = 450. At (40, 15): Z = 720 + 135 = 855. The maximum value is 855 at (40, 15) and the minimum is 450 at (15, 20). Therefore option (C) is correct.

questions.text: यदि A तथा B व्युत्क्रमणीय आव्यूह हैं, तो निम्न में से कौन सा सही नहीं है?
questions.text_english: If A and B are invertible matrices, then which of the following is not correct?
questions.solution: Option (A) states (A + B)^(-1) = B^(-1) + A^(-1), which is generally false. The inverse of a sum of matrices is not the sum of their inverses. Option (B) (AB)^(-1) = B^(-1)A^(-1) is the reversal law and is true. Option (C) adj(A) = |A|A^(-1) is true by definition of adjoint. Option (D) |A^(-1)| = |A|^(-1) is true. Therefore option (A) is the incorrect statement.

questions.text: एक रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या, जिसका उद्देश्य फलन Z = ax + by है, का सुसंगत क्षेत्र एक परिबद्ध क्षेत्र है, तो निम्न में से कौन सा सही है?
questions.text_english: If the feasible region of a linear programming problem with objective function Z = ax + by, is bounded, then which of the following is correct?

options.A: It will only have a maximum value.
options.B: It will only have a minimum value.
options.C: It will have both maximum and minimum values.
options.D: It will have neither maximum nor minimum value.

options_english.A: It will only have a maximum value.
options_english.B: It will only have a minimum value.
options_english.C: It will have both maximum and minimum values.
options_english.D: It will have neither maximum nor minimum value.

questions.solution: By the Fundamental Theorem of Linear Programming, if the feasible region is bounded (closed and bounded), then the objective function Z = ax + by attains both its maximum and minimum values on the feasible region, specifically at the corner points. Therefore option (C) is correct. Options (A) and (B) are partial truths, and option (D) is completely wrong for a bounded feasible region.
questions.topic: Bounded Feasible Region and Optimal Values

questions.text: वक्र y² = x, x = 4 तथा x-अक्ष के बीच के छायांकित क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल प्रदत्त है:
questions.text_english: The area of the shaded region bounded by the curves y² = x, x = 4 and the x-axis is given by
questions.solution: The curve y² = x gives y = √x for the upper half (since the region is bounded by x-axis, we take y ≥ 0). The shaded region lies between x = 0 and x = 4, bounded above by y = √x and below by the x-axis. The area is ∫₀⁴ √x dx. Option (D) is therefore correct. Option (C) would give twice the area; options (A) and (B) represent different integrals.

questions.text: एक त्रिकोणमितीय फलन का ग्राफ दिया गया है। निम्न में से कौन सा इसके व्युत्क्रम के ग्राफ को दर्शाता है?
questions.text_english: The graph of a trigonometric function is as shown. Which of the following will represent graph of its inverse?

options.A: Graph showing an S-curve passing through origin with domain [-π/2, π/2] and range [-1, 1]
options.B: Graph showing a curve with domain [-π/2, π/2] and range [-1, 1] (different shape)
options.C: Graph showing decreasing curve from (-1, π) to (1, 0) in horizontal orientation
options.D: Graph showing curve from (0, π) decreasing shape

options_english.A: Graph showing an S-curve passing through origin with domain [-π/2, π/2] and range [-1, 1]
options_english.B: Graph showing a curve with domain [-π/2, π/2] and range [-1, 1] (different shape)
options_english.C: Graph showing decreasing curve from (-1, π) to (1, 0) in horizontal orientation
options_english.D: Graph showing curve from (0, π) decreasing shape

questions.solution: The given graph shows the sine function. The inverse of sine is arcsin (sin⁻¹ x), which has domain [-1, 1] and range [-π/2, π/2]. The graph of the inverse function is the reflection of the original graph about the line y = x. Among the options, option (D) correctly represents the graph of the inverse trigonometric function with the appropriate domain and range orientation.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): माना Z पूर्णांकों का समुच्चय है। एक फलन f: Z → Z, जो f(x) = 3x - 5, ∀x ∈ Z द्वारा परिभाषित है, एकैकी-आच्छादक है।
तर्क (R): वह फलन जो एकैकी है तथा आच्छादक भी है, एकैकी-आच्छादक होता है।
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): Let Z be the set of integers. A function f: Z → Z defined as f(x) = 3x - 5, ∀x ∈ Z is a bijective.
Reason (R): A function is a bijective if it is both surjective and injective.
questions.instruction_line: निर्देश: प्रश्न संख्या 19 और 20 अभिकथन (A) और तर्क (R) आधारित प्रश्न हैं। सही उत्तर नीचे दिए गए कोडों (A), (B), (C) और (D) में से चुनकर दीजिए।
questions.instruction_line_english: Direction: Questions 19 and 20 are Assertion (A) and Reason (R) based questions. Select the correct answer from the options (A), (B), (C) and (D).

options.A: दोनों, अभिकथन (A) तथा तर्क (R) सही हैं। तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या करता है।
options.B: दोनों, अभिकथन (A) तथा तर्क (R) सही हैं परंतु तर्क (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं करता है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सही है परन्तु तर्क (R) गलत है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) गलत है जबकि तर्क (R) सही है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and the Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: Assertion (A): f(x) = 3x - 5. It is injective because f(x₁) = f(x₂) implies 3x₁ - 5 = 3x₂ - 5, so x₁ = x₂. It is surjective because for any y ∈ Z, x = (y+5)/3 must be an integer, which is not always the case (e.g., y = 0 gives x = 5/3 ∉ Z). So f is injective but not surjective, hence not bijective. Assertion (A) is FALSE. Reason (R) is true by definition. Therefore option (D) is correct.

questions.text:
अभिकथन (A): f(x) = {3x - 8, x ≤ 5; 2k, x > 5} k = 5/2 के लिए, x = 5 पर संतत है।
तर्क (R): x = a पर फलन f संतत है यदि lim(x→a⁻) f(x) = lim(x→a⁺) f(x) = f(a)
questions.text_english:
Assertion (A): f(x) = {3x - 8, x ≤ 5; 2k, x > 5} is continuous at x = 5 for k = 5/2.
Reason (R): For a function f to be continuous at x = a, lim(x→a⁻) f(x) = lim(x→a⁺) f(x) = f(a).

options.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and the Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and the Reason (R) is the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of the Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: For Assertion (A): At x = 5, f(5) = 3(5) - 8 = 7. LHL = lim(x→5⁻) (3x-8) = 7. RHL = lim(x→5⁺) 2k = 2(5/2) = 5. Since LHL ≠ RHL, f is not continuous at x = 5 for k = 5/2. Assertion (A) is FALSE. Wait, for continuity: f(5) = 3(5)-8 = 7 and 2k = 2(5/2) = 5 ≠ 7. So Assertion (A) is false. Reason (R) is the correct definition of continuity, so it is TRUE. Therefore option (D) is correct.

questions.text:
(a) 2^(cos²x) का cos²x के सापेक्ष अवकलन कीजिए।
अथवा
(b) यदि tan⁻¹(x² + y²) = a² है, तो dy/dx ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Differentiate 2^(cos²x) w.r.t. cos²x.
OR
(b) If tan⁻¹(x² + y²) = a², then find dy/dx.

key_points: (a) Let t = cos²x. Then d(2^t)/dt = 2^t · log 2 = 2^(cos²x) · log 2
(b) Differentiate tan⁻¹(x²+y²)=a² implicitly to get dy/dx = -x/y

questions.solution:
(a) Let t = cos²x. We need d(2^t)/dt. By the standard result, d(a^t)/dt = a^t · log a. Therefore d(2^(cos²x))/d(cos²x) = 2^(cos²x) · log 2.

(b) Given tan⁻¹(x² + y²) = a². Differentiating both sides with respect to x: 1/(1+(x²+y²)²) · (2x + 2y dy/dx) = 0. Since a² is a constant, the right-hand side is 0. Therefore 2x + 2y dy/dx = 0, giving dy/dx = -x/y.
questions.topic: Differentiation of Exponential Functions and Implicit Differentiation

questions.text: मान ज्ञात कीजिए: tan⁻¹[2 sin(2 cos⁻¹ (√3/2))]
questions.text_english: Evaluate: tan⁻¹[2 sin(2 cos⁻¹ (√3/2))]
questions.solution: First, cos⁻¹(√3/2) = π/6 since cos(π/6) = √3/2. Then 2 cos⁻¹(√3/2) = 2 × π/6 = π/3. Next, sin(π/3) = √3/2, so 2 sin(π/3) = 2 × √3/2 = √3. Finally, tan⁻¹(√3) = π/3 since tan(π/3) = √3. Therefore tan⁻¹[2 sin(2 cos⁻¹ (√3/2))] = π/3.

questions.text: एक समांतर चतुर्भुज का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए जिसके विकर्ण ⃗a = 2î - ĵ + k̂ तथा ⃗b = î + 3ĵ - k̂ द्वारा निरूपित हैं।
questions.text_english: The diagonals of a parallelogram are given by ⃗a = 2î - ĵ + k̂ and ⃗b = î + 3ĵ - k̂. Find the area of the parallelogram.
questions.topic: Cross Product and Area of Parallelogram

questions.text: वे अंतराल ज्ञात कीजिए जिनमें फलन f(x) = 5x^(3/2) - 3x^(5/2) (i) वर्धमान है (ii) हासमान है।
questions.text_english: Find the intervals in which function f(x) = 5x^(3/2) - 3x^(5/2) is (i) increasing (ii) decreasing.
questions.solution: f(x) = 5x^(3/2) - 3x^(5/2). Differentiating: f'(x) = 5 · (3/2)x^(1/2) - 3 · (5/2)x^(3/2) = (15/2)x^(1/2) - (15/2)x^(3/2) = (15/2)√x(1 - x). The domain requires x ≥ 0. Setting f'(x) = 0: √x = 0 or 1 - x = 0, giving x = 0 or x = 1. For 0 < x < 1: (15/2)√x > 0 and (1-x) > 0, so f'(x) > 0 — f is increasing on (0, 1). For x > 1: (15/2)√x > 0 and (1-x) < 0, so f'(x) < 0 — f is decreasing on (1, ∞).

questions.text:
(a) दो मित्र अलग-अलग स्थानों से पतंग उड़ाते समय पाते हैं कि उनकी पतंग की डोर एक दूसरे को छू रही है। डोरियों को सदिशों ⃗a = 3î + ĵ + 2k̂ तथा ⃗b = 2î - 2ĵ + 4k̂ द्वारा निरूपित किया जा सकता है। यह मानते हुए कि डोरियों में कोई ढील नहीं है, उनके बीच का कोण ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(b) परिमाण 21 इकाई का एक सदिश ज्ञात कीजिए जो सदिश →AB की विपरीत दिशा में हो जहाँ A(2, 1, 3) तथा B(8, -1, 0) हैं।
questions.text_english:
(a) Two friends while flying kites from different locations, find the strings of their kites crossing each other. The strings can be represented by vectors ⃗a = 3î + ĵ + 2k̂ and ⃗b = 2î - 2ĵ + 4k̂. Determine the angle formed between the kite strings. Assume there is no slack in the strings.

questions.text: एक समबाहु त्रिभुज की भुजा 3 cm/s की दर से बढ़ रही है। इसके क्षेत्रफल के बढ़ने की दर ज्ञात कीजिए जब भुजा 15 cm हो।
questions.text_english: The side of an equilateral triangle is increasing at the rate of 3 cm/s. At what rate its area increasing when the side of the triangle is 15 cm?
questions.solution: Let the side of the equilateral triangle be a cm. The area of an equilateral triangle is A = (√3/4)a². Differentiating both sides with respect to time t: dA/dt = (√3/4) · 2a · da/dt = (√3/2) · a · da/dt. Given da/dt = 3 cm/s and a = 15 cm. Therefore dA/dt = (√3/2) × 15 × 3 = 45√3/2 cm²/s. The area of the equilateral triangle is increasing at the rate of 45√3/2 cm²/s when the side is 15 cm.

questions.text:
निम्न रैखिक प्रोग्रामन समस्या को ग्राफ द्वारा हल कीजिए:
व्यवरोधों x - y ≥ 0, x - 2y ≥ -2, x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0 के अंतर्गत Z = x + 2y का अधिकतमीकरण करना।
questions.text_english:
Solve the following linear programming problem graphically:
Maximise Z = x + 2y
Subject to the constraints:
x - y ≥ 0
x - 2y ≥ -2
x ≥ 0, y ≥ 0

key_points: Find corner points of feasible region
Intersection of x-y=0 and x-2y=-2: solving gives x=2, y=2

questions.solution: Converting constraints: x - y ≥ 0 means y ≤ x; x - 2y ≥ -2 means x - 2y + 2 ≥ 0. The feasible region is determined by plotting these lines. The line x = y passes through origin with slope 1. The line x - 2y = -2 passes through (0,1) and (-2,0). Finding corner points: intersection of x = y and x - 2y = -2 gives x - 2x = -2, so x = 2, y = 2, point (2, 2). The feasible region is unbounded in the direction of increasing x. Evaluating Z at corner point (2, 2): Z = 2 + 4 = 6. Since the region is unbounded and Z increases as we move away, there is no maximum value for Z. The problem has an unbounded solution.

questions.text:
(a) ज्ञात कीजिए: ∫ (x + sin x)/(1 + cos x) dx
अथवा
(b) मान ज्ञात कीजिए: ∫₀^(π/4) dx / (cos³x √(2 sin 2x))
questions.text_english:
(a) Find: ∫ (x + sin x)/(1 + cos x) dx
OR
(b) Evaluate: ∫₀^(π/4) dx / (cos³x √(2 sin 2x))

key_points: (b) Use sin 2x = 2 sin x cos x and simplify, answer = 1

questions.solution:
(a) ∫ (x + sin x)/(1 + cos x) dx. Using 1 + cos x = 2cos²(x/2) and sin x = 2sin(x/2)cos(x/2): = ∫ [x + 2sin(x/2)cos(x/2)] / [2cos²(x/2)] dx = ∫ x/(2cos²(x/2)) dx + ∫ sin(x/2)/cos(x/2) dx = ∫ (x/2)sec²(x/2) dx + ∫ tan(x/2) dx. For the first part, using integration by parts with u = x/2 and dv = sec²(x/2)dx: = (x/2)·2tan(x/2) - ∫ tan(x/2)dx + ∫ tan(x/2)dx = x tan(x/2) + C.

(b) ∫₀^(π/4) dx/(cos³x√(2sin2x)). Since sin2x = 2sinxcosx: √(2sin2x) = √(4sinxcosx) = 2√(sinxcosx). So the integral = ∫₀^(π/4) dx/(2cos³x√(sinxcosx)) = (1/2)∫₀^(π/4) dx/(cos³x·cos^(1/2)x·sin^(1/2)x) = (1/2)∫₀^(π/4) sec³x·sec^(1/2)x·cosec^(1/2)x dx. Dividing numerator and denominator by cos²x and letting t = tanx gives ∫₀¹ t^(-1/2) dt·2 ... simplifying yields the value 1.

questions.text:
(a) किसी शनिवार, एक कक्षा में विद्यार्थियों की अनुपस्थिति की संख्या का प्रायिकता बंटन नीचे दिया गया है:
X: 0, 2, 4, 5 | P(X): p, 2p, 3p, p
जहाँ X, अनुपस्थित रहने वाले विद्यार्थियों की संख्या है।
(i) p का मान ज्ञात कीजिए। (ii) शनिवार को अनुपस्थित रहने वाले विद्यार्थियों की संख्या का माध्य ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(b) समाचार पत्र में विज्ञापित रिक्तियों के लिए 3000 उम्मीदवारों ने आवेदन दिए। प्राप्त आँकड़ों से यह पाया गया कि कुल आवेदनकर्ताओं का 2/3 भाग महिलाएँ थीं तथा शेष पुरुष थे। नौकरी के लिए चयन लिखित परीक्षा द्वारा किया गया। आवेदनकर्ताओं के प्रदर्शन से संकेत मिलता है कि लिखित परीक्षा में एक पुरुष के विशिष्ट अंक प्राप्त करने की प्रायिकता 0.4 है, तथा महिला के विशिष्ट अंक प्राप्त करने की प्रायिकता 0.35 है। प्रायिकता ज्ञात कीजिए कि यादृच्छया चुना गया आवेदक, लिखित परीक्षा में विशिष्ट अंक प्राप्त करने वाला है।
questions.text_english:
(a) The probability distribution for the number of students being absent in a class on a Saturday is as follows:
X: 0, 2, 4, 5 | P(X): p, 2p, 3p, p
Where X is the number of students absent.
(i) Calculate p. (ii) Calculate the mean of the number of absent students on Saturday.
OR
(b) For the vacancy advertised in the newspaper, 3000 candidates submitted their applications. From the data it was revealed that two third of the total applicants were females and other were males. The selection for the job was done through a written test. The performance of the applicants indicates that the probability of a male getting a distinction in written test is 0.4 and that a female getting a distinction is 0.35. Find the probability that the candidate chosen at random will have a distinction in the written test.
questions.solution:
(a)(i) The sum of all probabilities must equal 1: p + 2p + 3p + p = 1, so 7p = 1, giving p = 1/7.
(ii) Mean = E(X) = Σ x·P(X) = 0×(1/7) + 2×(2/7) + 4×(3/7) + 5×(1/7) = 0 + 4/7 + 12/7 + 5/7 = 21/7 = 3. The mean number of absent students is 3.

(b) P(Male) = 1/3, P(Female) = 2/3. P(Distinction|Male) = 0.4, P(Distinction|Female) = 0.35. By total probability theorem: P(Distinction) = P(Male)×P(D|Male) + P(Female)×P(D|Female) = (1/3)(0.4) + (2/3)(0.35) = 0.4/3 + 0.7/3 = 1.1/3 = 11/30. The required probability is 11/30.
questions.topic: Probability Distribution and Total Probability Theorem

questions.text: y = |x + 3| का ग्राफ बनाइए तथा समाकलन के प्रयोग से वक्र तथा x-अक्ष के बीच के उस क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए जो x = -6 तथा x = 0 के बीच में है।
questions.text_english: Sketch the graph of y = |x + 3| and find the area of the region enclosed by the curve, x-axis, between x = -6 and x = 0, using integration.

key_points: y = -(x+3) for x < -3 and y = x+3 for x ≥ -3

questions.solution: The function y = |x+3| has a corner at x = -3. For x < -3, y = -(x+3); for x ≥ -3, y = x+3. The graph is a V-shape with vertex at (-3, 0). Area = ∫₋₆⁻³ -(x+3) dx + ∫₋³⁰ (x+3) dx. First integral: [-(x²/2 + 3x)]₋₆⁻³ = [-(9/2 - 9)] - [-(36/2 - 18)] = [-9/2+9] - [-18+18] = 9/2. Second integral: [(x²/2 + 3x)]₋³⁰ = [0] - [9/2 - 9] = 0 - (-9/2) = 9/2. Total Area = 9/2 + 9/2 = 9 square units.

questions.text:
(a) यदि √(1-x²) + √(1-y²) = a(x-y) है, तो सिद्ध कीजिए कि dy/dx = √((1-y²)/(1-x²)).
अथवा
(b) यदि x = a(cosθ + log tan(θ/2)) तथा y = sinθ है, तो θ = π/4 पर d²y/dx² ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) If √(1-x²) + √(1-y²) = a(x-y), then prove that dy/dx = √((1-y²)/(1-x²)).
OR
(b) If x = a(cosθ + log tan(θ/2)) and y = sinθ, then find d²y/dx² at θ = π/4.

key_points: (a) Substitute x=sinα, y=sinβ to simplify and use cos(α-β)=a(sinα-sinβ)

questions.solution:
(a) Let x = sinα and y = sinβ. Then √(1-sin²α) + √(1-sin²β) = a(sinα - sinβ). So cosα + cosβ = a(sinα - sinβ). Using sum-to-product: 2cos((α+β)/2)cos((α-β)/2) = a · 2cos((α+β)/2)sin((α-β)/2). Dividing by 2cos((α+β)/2): cos((α-β)/2) = a sin((α-β)/2), so cot((α-β)/2) = a, giving α - β = 2cot⁻¹(a) = constant. Differentiating sin⁻¹x - sin⁻¹y = constant w.r.t. x: 1/√(1-x²) - (1/√(1-y²))(dy/dx) = 0. Therefore dy/dx = √(1-y²)/√(1-x²) = √((1-y²)/(1-x²)). Hence proved.

(b) dx/dθ = a(-sinθ + 1/(2sin(θ/2)cos(θ/2)) · 2cos²(θ/2)/(2·(1/2))) = a(-sinθ + 1/sinθ) = a(1-sin²θ)/sinθ = a cos²θ/sinθ. dy/dθ = cosθ. So dy/dx = cosθ × sinθ/(a cos²θ) = tanθ/a. d²y/dx² = d(dy/dx)/dθ × dθ/dx = (sec²θ/a) × sinθ/(acos²θ) = sinθ/(a²cos⁴θ) × ... At θ=π/4: tan(π/4)=1, sec²(π/4)=2, dx/dθ=acos²(π/4)/sin(π/4)=a(1/2)/(1/√2)=a/√2. d²y/dx²=(sec²θ/a)÷(acos²θ/sinθ)=sinθ·sec⁴θ/a². At θ=π/4: =(1/√2)×4/a²=4/(a²√2)=2√2/a².
questions.topic: Second Order Derivatives and Implicit Differentiation

questions.text: फलन f(x) = 2x³ - 15x² + 36x + 1 के [1, 5] में निरपेक्ष उच्चतम तथा निरपेक्ष न्यूनतम मान ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Find the absolute maximum and absolute minimum of function f(x) = 2x³ - 15x² + 36x + 1 on [1, 5].

key_points: Critical points in [1,5]: x = 2 and x = 3
Absolute maximum = 56 at x=5; Absolute minimum = 24 at x=1

questions.solution: f(x) = 2x³ - 15x² + 36x + 1. Differentiating: f'(x) = 6x² - 30x + 36 = 6(x² - 5x + 6) = 6(x - 2)(x - 3). Setting f'(x) = 0: x = 2 and x = 3, both of which lie in [1, 5]. Now evaluating f at the critical points and endpoints: f(1) = 2 - 15 + 36 + 1 = 24. f(2) = 16 - 60 + 72 + 1 = 29. f(3) = 54 - 135 + 108 + 1 = 28. f(5) = 250 - 375 + 180 + 1 = 56. Comparing all values: the absolute maximum value is 56 at x = 5, and the absolute minimum value is 24 at x = 1.
questions.topic: Absolute Maximum and Minimum on Closed Interval

questions.text:
(a) रेखा x/1 = (y-1)/2 = (z-2)/3 में बिंदु A(1, 6, 3) का प्रतिबिंब A' ज्ञात कीजिए। बिंदुओं A तथा A' को मिलाने वाली रेखा का समीकरण भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(b) रेखा (x+5)/1 = (y+3)/4 = (z-6)/(-9) पर एक ऐसा बिंदु P ज्ञात कीजिए जिसकी बिंदु Q(2, 4, -1) से दूरी 7 इकाई हो। P तथा Q को मिलाने वाली रेखा का समीकरण भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
(a) Find the image A' of the point A(1, 6, 3) in the line x/1 = (y-1)/2 = (z-2)/3. Also, find the equation of the line joining A and A'.
OR
(b) Find a point P on the line (x+5)/1 = (y+3)/4 = (z-6)/(-9) such that its distance from point Q(2, 4, -1) is 7 units. Also, find the equation of line joining P and Q.

key_points: (a) Foot of perpendicular from A to line, then reflect: A'=(1, 0, 7) after calculation
(b) P = (-5+λ, -3+4λ, 6-9λ); distance from Q=7 gives λ; P and equation of PQ

questions.solution:
(a) Let the foot of perpendicular from A(1,6,3) to the line x/1=(y-1)/2=(z-2)/3 be M(λ, 2λ+1, 3λ+2). Direction vector of line is (1,2,3). AM = (λ-1, 2λ-5, 3λ-1). For AM perpendicular to line: AM·(1,2,3) = 0. (λ-1)+2(2λ-5)+3(3λ-1)=0. λ-1+4λ-10+9λ-3=0. 14λ=14, λ=1. Foot M=(1,3,5). A'=2M-A=(2-1, 6-6, 10-3)=(1,0,7). Equation of line AA': (x-1)/0=(y-6)/(-6)=(z-3)/4, or simplified as x=1, (y-6)/(-6)=(z-3)/4.

(b) Any point P on the line: P=(-5+λ, -3+4λ, 6-9λ). Distance PQ=7: (λ-7)²+(4λ-7)²+(-9λ+7)²=49. Expanding: (λ²-14λ+49)+(16λ²-56λ+49)+(81λ²-126λ+49)=49. 98λ²-196λ+147=49. 98λ²-196λ+98=0. λ²-2λ+1=0. (λ-1)²=0, λ=1. P=(-4,1,-3). Equation of line PQ: (x-2)/(-6)=(y-4)/(-3)=(z+1)/(-2).
questions.topic: Image of a Point in a Line and Foot of Perpendicular

questions.text:
एक स्कूल अपने विद्यार्थियों को निम्न शर्तों के साथ तीन क्लबों में आबंटित करना चाहता है: खेल, संगीत और नाटक:
• खेल क्लब के विद्यार्थियों की संख्या, संगीत तथा नाटक क्लबों के विद्यार्थियों की संख्या के योगफल के समान हो।
• संगीत क्लब के विद्यार्थियों की संख्या, खेल क्लब के विद्यार्थियों की संख्या के आधे से 20 अधिक हो।
• इन तीनों क्लबों में आबंटित विद्यार्थियों की कुल संख्या 180 हो।
मैट्रिक विधि द्वारा विभिन्न क्लबों में आबंटित विद्यार्थियों की संख्या ज्ञात कीजिए।
questions.text_english:
A school wants to allocate students into three clubs: Sports, Music and Drama, under following conditions:
• The number of students in Sports club should be equal to the sum of the number of students in Music and Drama club.
• The number of students in Music club should be 20 more than half the number of students in Sports club.
• The total number of students to be allocated in all three clubs are 180.
Find the number of students allocated to different clubs, using matrix method.

key_points: From eq1: x=y+z; from eq3: x+x=180 so x=90

questions.solution: Let the number of students in Sports, Music, and Drama clubs be x, y, and z respectively. From the given conditions: (i) x = y + z, (ii) y = x/2 + 20, (iii) x + y + z = 180. From (i): x - y - z = 0. From (ii): -x/2 + y = 20, or -x + 2y = 40. From (iii): x + y + z = 180. Writing in matrix form AX = B where A = [[1,-1,-1],[-1,2,0],[1,1,1]], X = [x,y,z]^T, B = [0,40,180]^T. |A| = 1(2-0)+1(-1-0)+(-1)(-1-2) = 2-1+3 = 4 ≠ 0. Computing A^(-1) and solving: From (i) and (iii): x + (y+z) = 180 and x = y+z, so 2x = 180, x = 90. From (ii): y = 45 + 20 = 65. From (i): z = x - y = 90 - 65 = 25. Sports club: 90 students, Music club: 65 students, Drama club: 25 students.
questions.topic: System of Linear Equations using Matrix Method

questions.text:
एक टेक्निकल कम्पनी आयताकार सौर पैनल बना रही है। जिन्हें छत पर लगाने के लिए उसके पास 300 मीटर सीमा पर लगाने की सामग्री है। पैनल के डिजाइन में एक साइड के समांतर विभाजन है जो पैनल को दो भागों में बाँटता है। माना विभाजन के लंबवत वाली भुजा की लंबाई x मीटर तथा इसके समांतर वाली भुजा की लंबाई y मीटर है।
उपरोक्त सूचना के आधार पर निम्न प्रश्नों के उत्तर दीजिए:
(i) सीमा की कुल सामग्री जो सीमा तथा समांतर विभाजन में प्रयोग होनी है, के प्रयोग से x तथा y में बनी समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
(ii) सौर पैनल का क्षेत्रफल x के फलन के रूप में लिखिए।
(iii)(a) क्षेत्रफल फलन के क्रांतिक बिंदु ज्ञात कीजिए। द्वितीय अवकलज के प्रयोग से वह क्रांतिक बिंदु ज्ञात कीजिए जिस पर क्षेत्रफल अधिकतम है। अधिकतम क्षेत्रफल भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
अथवा
(iii)(b) प्रथम अवकलज परीक्षण के प्रयोग से 300 मीटर सीमा सामग्री के प्रयोग से परिबद्ध अधिकतम क्षेत्र का क्षेत्रफल ज्ञात कीजिए जहाँ समांतर विभाजन को भी लिया गया है।
questions.text_english:
A technical company is designing a rectangular solar panel installation on a roof using 300 metres of boundary material. The design includes a partition running parallel to one of the sides dividing the area (roof) into two sections. Let the length of the side perpendicular to the partition be x metres and with parallel to the partition be y metres.
Based on this information, answer the following questions:
(i) Write the equation for the total boundary material used in the boundary and parallel to the partition in terms of x and y.
(ii) Write the area of the solar panel as a function of x.
(iii)(a) Find the critical points of the area function. Use second derivative test to determine critical points at the maximum area. Also, find the maximum area.
OR
(iii)(b) Using first derivative test, calculate the maximum area the company can enclose with the 300 metres of boundary material, considering the parallel partition.

sub_questions.text: सीमा की कुल सामग्री जो सीमा तथा समांतर विभाजन में प्रयोग होनी है, के प्रयोग से x तथा y में बनी समीकरण ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the equation for the total boundary material used in the boundary and parallel to the partition in terms of x and y.

key_points: 2x + 3y = 300 (since there are 2 sides of length x, 2 sides of length y, and 1 partition of length y)

sub_questions.solution: The rectangular panel has 2 sides of length x and 2 sides of length y. Additionally, there is one partition parallel to the side of length y (internal divider), which also has length y. Total material = 2x + 2y + y = 2x + 3y. Since total material available is 300 m, the equation is 2x + 3y = 300.

sub_questions.text: सौर पैनल का क्षेत्रफल x के फलन के रूप में लिखिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Write the area of the solar panel as a function of x.
sub_questions.solution: From the constraint 2x + 3y = 300, we get y = (300 - 2x)/3. The area A = x × y = x × (300-2x)/3 = (300x - 2x²)/3. Therefore A(x) = 100x - (2/3)x².

sub_questions.text: क्षेत्रफल फलन के क्रांतिक बिंदु ज्ञात कीजिए। द्वितीय अवकलज के प्रयोग से वह क्रांतिक बिंदु ज्ञात कीजिए जिस पर क्षेत्रफल अधिकतम है। अधिकतम क्षेत्रफल भी ज्ञात कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Find the critical points of the area function. Use second derivative test to determine critical points at the maximum area. Also, find the maximum area.

key_points: A''(x) = -4/3 < 0, so x=75 is a maximum

sub_questions.solution: A(x) = 100x - (2/3)x². Differentiating: A'(x) = 100 - (4/3)x. Setting A'(x) = 0: 100 = (4/3)x, so x = 75. This is the critical point. A''(x) = -4/3 < 0, which confirms x = 75 gives a maximum. Maximum area = A(75) = 100(75) - (2/3)(75)² = 7500 - (2/3)(5625) = 7500 - 3750 = 3750 m².

sub_questions.text: संबंध ज्ञात कीजिए जो स्वतुल्य और संक्रामक है परन्तु सममित नहीं है।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify the relation which is reflexive, transitive but not symmetric.
sub_questions.solution: R₄ = {(1,1),(1,2),(3,3),(2,2)} contains all diagonal pairs (1,1),(2,2),(3,3), so it is reflexive. It is transitive: (1,1) and (1,2) give (1,2) which is present. However, (1,2) is present but (2,1) is not, so it is not symmetric. Therefore R₄ is reflexive and transitive but not symmetric.

sub_questions.text: संबंध ज्ञात कीजिए जो स्वतुल्य और सममित है परन्तु संक्रामक नहीं है।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify the relation which is reflexive and symmetric but not transitive.
sub_questions.solution: R₅ = {(1,1),(1,2),(3,3),(2,2),(2,1),(2,3),(3,2)} contains (1,1),(2,2),(3,3) so it is reflexive. For every (a,b) in R₅, (b,a) is also present, so it is symmetric. However, (1,2) and (2,3) are present but (1,3) is not, so it is not transitive. Therefore R₅ is reflexive and symmetric but not transitive.

sub_questions.text: संबंध ज्ञात कीजिए जो सममित हैं पर न तो स्वतुल्य और न ही संक्रामक है।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify the relations which are symmetric but neither reflexive nor transitive.
sub_questions.solution: R₁ = {(2,3),(3,2)}: It contains (2,3) and (3,2), so it is symmetric. It does not contain (1,1),(2,2),(3,3), so it is not reflexive. For transitivity: (2,3) and (3,2) should give (2,2), which is not in R₁, so it is not transitive. Therefore R₁ is symmetric but neither reflexive nor transitive.

questions.text:
एक बैंक अपने ग्राहकों को विभिन्न प्रकार के ब्याज पर ऋण उपलब्ध कराता है, जैसे कि फिक्सड दर, फ्लोटिंग दर और वेरिएबल दर। बैंक के पिछले आँकड़ों से यह ज्ञात है कि ग्राहक फिक्सड दर, फ्लोटिंग दर या वेरिएबल दर पर क्रमश: 10%, 20% और 70% प्रायिकता के साथ ऋण प्राप्त करते हैं। ऋण लेने के बाद ग्राहक ऋण का भुगतान कर सकता है या ऋण चुकाने में चूक भी कर सकता है। बैंक के आँकड़ों से पता चलता है कि फिक्सड रेट, फ्लोटिंग रेट और वेरिएबल रेट पर ऋण लेने के बाद किसी व्यक्ति द्वारा ऋण भुगतान पर चूक करने की प्रायिकता क्रमश: 5%, 3% और 1% है।
उपरोक्त के आधार पर निम्न के उत्तर दीजिए:
(i) ऋण लेने के बाद एक ग्राहक के ऋण चुकाने में चूक करने की क्या प्रायिकता है?
(ii) एक ग्राहक ऋण लेने के बाद चुकाने में चूक करता है। क्या प्रायिकता है कि उसने वेरिएबल दर ब्याज पर ऋण लिया था?
questions.text_english:
A bank offers loan to its customers on different types of interest namely, fixed rate, floating rate and variable rate. From the past data with the bank, it is known that a customer avails loan on fixed rate, floating rate or variable rate with probabilities 10%, 20% and 70% respectively. A customer after availing loan can pay the loan or default on loan repayment. The bank data suggests that the probability that a person defaults on loan after availing it at fixed rate, floating rate and variable rate is 5%, 3% and 1% respectively.
Based on the above information, answer the following:
(i) What is the probability that a customer after availing the loan will default on the loan repayment?
(ii) A customer after availing the loan, defaults on loan repayment. What is the probability that he availed the loan at a variable rate of interest?

sub_questions.text: ऋण लेने के बाद एक ग्राहक के ऋण चुकाने में चूक करने की क्या प्रायिकता है?
sub_questions.text_english: What is the probability that a customer after availing the loan will default on the loan repayment?
sub_questions.solution: Let F = Fixed rate, Fl = Floating rate, V = Variable rate, and D = Default. Given: P(F) = 0.10, P(Fl) = 0.20, P(V) = 0.70, P(D|F) = 0.05, P(D|Fl) = 0.03, P(D|V) = 0.01. By total probability theorem: P(D) = P(F)×P(D|F) + P(Fl)×P(D|Fl) + P(V)×P(D|V) = (0.10)(0.05) + (0.20)(0.03) + (0.70)(0.01) = 0.005 + 0.006 + 0.007 = 0.018. The probability that a customer defaults on loan repayment is 0.018 or 1.8%.

sub_questions.text: एक ग्राहक ऋण लेने के बाद चुकाने में चूक करता है। क्या प्रायिकता है कि उसने वेरिएबल दर ब्याज पर ऋण लिया था?
sub_questions.text_english: A customer after availing the loan, defaults on loan repayment. What is the probability that he availed the loan at a variable rate of interest?
sub_questions.solution: Using Bayes' theorem: P(V|D) = P(V)×P(D|V) / P(D) = (0.70 × 0.01) / 0.018 = 0.007 / 0.018 = 7/18. The probability that the customer who defaulted had availed the loan at variable rate is 7/18 ≈ 0.389.
